verdicts.claim: Every level earned re-runs exactly (both minds re-expressed on the same bytes give the receipt’s numbers) and deeply (the search it names, run again, finds the very mind it carries).
Five forgeries of every level — a raised score, a lowered start, another ground, another mind, another search — are each refused by the re-run.
Every leveled card is recorded by a registry only with the re-runner; without it, the registry refuses the level.
verdicts.saw: 69 recorded with the re-runner; 69 refused without it, of 69

verdicts.claim: Levels earned on GATE hold on TEST: in at least 60% of levels, the new mind’s TEST AUC is above the old mind’s.
Across all levels, the mean TEST gain is above zero, with its bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero.
verdicts.saw: mean TEST gain 0.0010, bootstrap 95% lower bound -0.0018

verdicts.claim: At least 25% of the sampled cards earn a level within their three searches.
verdicts.saw: 69 of 100 cards earned a level in three searches
